primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-spaces-stack (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3566-3571

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: checks the three stack conditions: (1) fibred in groupoids by the quot lemma; (2) Isom sheaves via the diagonal lemma in the fp,flat,proper case and via the Examples of Stacks pre-stack lemma in the finite type case; (3) descent of objects via effectivity of fppf descent data for algebraic spaces (Bootstrap lemma part (2)), with finite type (and in the fp,flat,proper case finite presentation, flatness, properness) descending along the fppf covering (source lines 3573-3623)
